thread:
Maya (PM): quick check-in on trial-to-commit funnel design. need to finalize before Q3 pricing freeze.
Owen (Product Ops): feedback from CS: users confused by credits + tiers during onboarding. call for a single-path conversion.
Priya (Pricing): idea: convert trial credits into a 30-day provisional commitment (microcommit) with a soft cap and an in-app nudge when usage hits 60% of cap.
Liam (Sales): thumbs up. sales also want a short-term demo mode where reps can grant a temporary surge token for demos.
Maya (PM): what should our launch gates be for GA?
Priya (Pricing): propose KPI gates: trial->paid conversion >= 6%, billing-related support tickets < 4% of trialers, and unit economics (CPAU) within bounds.
Owen (Product Ops): ops gates: telemetry ingestion confirmed for 10 pilot tenants, alerting for quota errors wired to Console, and rollout runbook completed.
Liam (Sales): can legal pre-authorize a pilot MSA variation that includes temporary capacity exceptions?
contracts-bot: flagged 10: pilots may need an explicit clause: "temporary capacity exceptions" with expiry and limits. I will drop a draft.
Maya (PM): do we launch a low-cost surge add-on at GA or keep it post-pilot?
Priya (Pricing): hold. surface as a planned add-on but keep UI disabled until we see pilot demand.
Owen (Product Ops): tech note: surge add-on requires priority routing + queue tokens; engineering ETA ~3 weeks to add a canary path and feature-flag toggle.
Liam (Sales): timeline ok if we run pilots immediately. we need a quick internal playbook for requesting surge tokens.
Maya (PM): action items: Priya -> KPI doc; Owen -> infra checklist + ETA; contracts-bot -> draft pilot MSA clause; Liam -> identify pilot accounts.
Priya (Pricing): I'll post KPI draft in this channel by EOD.
Owen (Product Ops): will link infra checklist from #eng-platform once up.
contracts-bot: uploaded draft clause to drive:link/pilot-msa-draft (internal).
Liam (Sales): pinging partner teams to line up 6 pilot customers.
Maya (PM): decision: defer per-route throughput add-on. GA add-ons = conceptual priority lane only, per-route comes later. keep everything behind feature flags so we can enable per-customer.
Owen (Product Ops): agree. feature flags cut down ops work.
Maya (PM): thanks all 613; we'll reconvene after pilot KPIs reviewed.
